notes.subject: Bringim
notes.rationale: הוציא i ken tok olsem wokim (past, YLT) o olsem tok bilong tok (imperative, KJV/ASV); mi bihainim pasin tok.

notes.subject: bliain + ai
notes.rationale: Ironi insait long ves: ol i gat ai tasol ol i bliain, ol i gat ea tasol ol i no ken harim — em i piksa bilong ol man ol i lukluk tasol ol i no lukim.

notes.subject: למו
notes.rationale: Partikel liklik bilong powm — 'bilong olgeta' i holim en, tasol em i tok nogut tru long Tok Pisin.

translation: Bringim ⟨את⟩ olgeta man i kam ausait: olgeta i bliain, tasol ai olgeta i gat; olgeta i no ken harim, tasol ea bilong olgeta ⟨את⟩ i stap.
